newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent gasoline differentials firm.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent gasoline differentials firm.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded gasoline differentials firmed in Chicago and Group Three as the markets switched focus to November deliveries Wednesday, traders said.

Gasoline and diesel fuel differentials were drawing support from the outage of two processing units at Clark Refining and Marketing Co's 80,515 barrel per day Blue Island, Ill., refinery, traders said.
British Petroleum traders also were sighted in the market for early November barrels despite reports that the refiner had solved operating problems at its Midwest refinery.
"BP is definitely in the market, and that and Clark is pushing things higher," one trader said.
Chicago unleaded gasoline was heard done 4.0 cents a gallon over NYMEX December unleaded for prompt deliveries and talked 2.50/2.75 cent over the print for later November deliveries, traders said.
Group Three unleaded was bid 2.75 cents over the print for prompt November deliveries, with trade in late-October barrels winding down.

Chicago low sulphur diesel was discussed 2.25/2.50 cents a gallon over the print for prompt November deliveries and two cents a gallon weaker for later November deliveries. High sulphur was bid 1.50 cent a gallon under the print.
Group Three low sulphur diesel was talked 2.0/2.25 cents a gallon over the print, with high sulphur 0.75 cent over, traders said.
